verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a reconciliation report suite, including a Financial Actions by Payout ID Report, a Payouts Report, and a Settlement Breakdown Report, that maps each payout to its underlying financial actions and fee categories. The evidence pack has nothing on letting a finance-ops user set or change the payout schedule (frequency, timing, holds), so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented payout schedule control, explicit per-payout line-item detail for charges/fees/refunds, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout

citations.quote: Financial Actions by Date Range Report, Financial Actions by Payout ID Report, Payouts Report, Settlement Breakdown Report, Settlement Statement
You can reconcile your balances, fee categories, financial actions, invoices, and settlements
